backtest_protocol.execution_model: Signal uses only close-of-day OHLCV available on the signal date; paper entry is next available open with production entry slippage; exit is the close ten trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.

gate2.note: The sleeve uses only same-day and prior-day OHLCV fields plus next-open/exit prices available to the replay. It does not ask LLM or production to infer hidden fields.
runtime_fields: SPY OHLCV rows for same-window relative strength
candidate ticker OHLCV Volume for 50 trading days before signal date
candidate ticker OHLCV Volume for 10 trading days before signal date

gate3.note: No core filter is added. The volume dry-up condition gates only the default-off replay paper variant; core signals_generated/signals_survived remain unchanged.

hypothesis: Among exp-20260525-022 QQQ-confirmed volatility-contraction candidates, pre-signal volume dry-up may identify cleaner supply contraction before the breakout and improve replacement value.

next_evidence_needed: Use forward paper outcomes or a materially new free-data confirmation source before revisiting. Do not retune the 10v50 threshold on this frozen sample.
